decision.explanation: The provided documents contain conflicting claims regarding the release date of 'Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition'. Document D1 (and card d1:c0) asserts the release date was May 9, 2012, while Document D2 (and card d2:c0) asserts it was May 29, 2020. Both sources explicitly link these dates to the same entity and scope ('released worldwide for the Nintendo Switch'). Per the instruction to preserve separately valid referents and complementary answers where competing assertions exist without external resolution, both dates are included as they represent distinct supported claims within the source material.
